name: librarian
description: Retrieve ranked Europe PMC evidence passages for biomedical research questions.

interface.shortDescription: Ranked Europe PMC evidence for biomedical questions
interface.longDescription: Retrieves and ranks scientific evidence passages from Europe PMC for a biomedical research question: generates targeted sub-queries, retrieves and BM25-ranks full-text paragraphs, and applies an LLM relevance filter so you get citable, ranked evidence instead of raw search results.
defaultPrompt: Find evidence on whether metformin affects lifespan.
What does the literature say about CRISPR off-target effects?
Summarize recent evidence on gut microbiome and depression.
